_note: Virtual mailbox services the store sells (Peter, Nov 19 2026). Each one gets its own tab on Counter → Virtual mail. To add one, copy a line and give it a new id (letters only) and its name. 'api' is true once we connect its API. 'api_base' is the web address of its API from the service's documentation and 'renters_path' the List Renters path (to-do P18); the key is pasted on the service's tab by an owner. 'deactivate' and 'delete' are the Deactivate Renter and Delete Renter calls as {"method": "POST", "path": "/renters/{renter_id}/..."}, copied exactly from their docs; null keeps those buttons off. 'mailboxes_path' is List Mailboxes (each box's status: available, assigned, pending-assignment); only renters with an assigned box are real customers.
